app_fee.value: A non-refundable EUR 30 payment is due for each application, paid through PagoPA.
app_fee.quote: A non-refundable payment of € 30.00 must be made for each application.

fee_waiver.value: No application-fee waiver is mentioned. The only exemption found is an ISEE-based one for the annual regional tax after enrolment.

also.quote: PhD students may request exemption from payment of the regional contribution, quantified as per the ISEE presented

gre_general.value: The call and FAQ do not mention the GRE. Programs state their own rules where they have one.

toefl_min.value: The call and FAQ set no TOEFL minimum. Language is assessed per course at the oral exam.

also.quote: For most courses, the exam can be carried in Italian, or English only | Many courses also include the language assessment of English proficiency

ielts_min.value: The call and FAQ set no IELTS minimum. Language is assessed per course at the oral exam.

also.quote: For most courses, the exam can be carried in Italian, or English only | Many courses also include the language assessment of English proficiency

english_waiver.value: No rule for degrees taught in English in India was found in the call or FAQ.

notes: Admission is by one university-wide annual call on pica.cineca.it, read here for the 42nd cycle (2026/27). The 43rd cycle (Fall 2027 entry) is not yet published, so no deadline is known. Official course list: https://www.unipd.it/en/dottorato/elenco (43 courses over five pages; STEM programs with their own information sheet are saved as program records). Not saved as separate records because a field allows only one program or the field is already taken: Fusion Science and Engineering (plasma physics, shares the physics field), Sciences, Technologies and Measurements for Space (mech field taken by Mechatronics; its GRE and TOEFL wording is 'if available'), Molecular Medicine, Oncology and Immunology, Clinical and Experimental Sciences, Pharmacological Sciences, Translational Medicine (all biomedical), Animal and Food Science, Crop Science, Veterinary Sciences (life sciences outside the field list). Not checked: Arterial Hypertension and Vascular Biology (ARHYVAB), Technologies for Fundamental Research in Physics and Astrophysics (not in the 42nd-cycle sheets). Not STEM and not saved: Economics, Law, humanities and social sciences, Developmental Medicine (Italian-taught), Management Engineering. The Scientific, Technological and Social Methods enabling Circular Economy program is listed for the 38th and 39th cycles only. No Padova program has a data-science PhD track, so no datasci record. Bioengineering is a curriculum of Information Engineering, so bme is listed as also_fields there.
